what_it_is.prose: Skyroot's Vikram-I lifted off from Satish Dhawan Space Centre on 18 July 2026, marking the first orbital launch by a private Indian company from Indian soil. ISRO states that SCOPE and Grahaa were injected into low Earth orbit. Skyroot's own site records the commercial Vikram launch programme and continuing development roadmap. The dossier treats the July 2026 flight as a verified orbital milestone while keeping future cadence, payload demand and localization percentages open unless separately disclosed.
